contexts.text: Sidon () = those who have been in the Knowledges of faith.

Canaan begat Sidon () = merely external worship [begat] the exterior Knowledges of spiritual things, which, being the first things of such external worship, it is said that Sidon was the firstborn of Canaan. AC 1201, Explained.

That Sidon = these Knowledges, is evident from the fact that Tyre and Sidon were the ultimate boundaries of Philistia, and in fact near the sea; and therefore Tyre = the interior, and Sidon, the exterior Knowledges. Illustrated.
The Sidonian () = exterior Knowledges, which, without internal things, are nothing but scientifics; therefore he is mentioned together with Pharaoh.
The Ancient Church extended through... Philistia even to Tyre and Sidon. AC 2385:5. AC 3240:5.
Sarepta is called of Sidon (), because Sidon = the Knowledges of good and truth.
The woman in Sidon () = the Church which is in the Knowledges of truth and good.
Tyre and Sidon, because near the sea, = the Church as to the Knowledges of good and truth.
Tyre and Sidon = those within the Church who are in the Knowledges of good and truth; here (), those who have perverted them, and have applied them to falsities and the evils of falsity. AE 433:14.
Sidon and Tyre = the Knowledges of good and truth. AE 406:11. AE 406:12. AE 721:3. AE 863:5.
The merchant of Sidon () = those in truths from the Word.
